5 Basic Well Requirements

1) The vertical amplitude of swing between designed trajectory and the actual trajectory

should be less than 2.0 m, while the lateral amplitude of swing should be no more than 10m;

2) The rate of overall angle change before the KOP should be less than 2.5 °per 30m;

More details refer to Well proposal of Well S19 (Drilling Geological Design)

8 Drilling Operation Procedure

8.1 Preparation and Drill 17-1/2" Hole Section (22-300m)

1) The 20"SOL X 21-1/4"2K should be installed before spud as Wellhead engineer

recommends. And install 21-1/4"2k upper flange welded 20" casing nipple on the

wellhead.

 M/U 1 stand DP +26" Bit to sweep the soil in 30” conductor and drill to about

24m (a joint 20"casing below the cellar bottom).

 POOH and run 20" casing string to bottom and space out the 20" SOL x 21-

1/4"2k wellhead as required .

 Cement the annular between 30" conductor and 20" casing.

 Cut the 30" conductor and 20" casing as required, grind the top end of 20"casing

and 30"conductor, install the 20" SOL x 21-1/4"2k wellhead and Bowl protector.

 Install a 21-1/4" 2k upper flange welded and bell nipple.

1) Drill the first and second stands to avoid washing out the conductor. Pump Hi-Vis pill to

sweep hole when every stand drills down.

2) Go on drilling to section TD 300 m.

3) Wiper trip should be conducted 150-200m or as per hole condition.

4) POOH to surface and run back to bottom, circulation again.

5) Pump Hi-Vis pill. Circulate hole clean. Drop single shot survey Tool.

6) POOH to surface, retrieve single shot Tool.

7) Run 13-3/8" casing as per casing tally. Set the 13-3/8" casing hanger in 21-1/4" 2K

casing head, but release the hang weight of the casing not more than 1ton to prevent the

20" conductor sink in the earth, the hook must hang the other weight of the casing string.

8) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 2000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

9) WOC. N/U 21-1/4" × 13-5/8" casing head. N/U BOP stack and Conduct BOP and

casing head Pressure test.

8.2 Drill 12-1/4" Hole Section (300-1562m)

1) RIH BHA with PDC to tag TOC. Drill cement to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms

up.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 11

2) Add NMDC in BHA, in order to do multi shot survey operation for this section.

3) If the plug-bumping failed, pressure test 13-3/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 2,000

psi/30mins @ 1.10sg mud, record the results in DDR.

4) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD@1562m as per drilling parameters. Take

survey every 200-400 m.

5) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again. Drop

Multi shot and POOH.

6) Run 9-5/8" casing as per casing tally. Casing specification and Centralizers Placement

as per cementing program.

7) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 3000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

8) WOC. N/D BOP, N/U 13-5/8" × 11" × 5 K casing head. N/U BOP stack, BOP and

casing head pressure test.

8.3 Drill 8-1/2" Pilot Hole Section (1562-3141m)

1) RIH to tag TOC carefully. Drill CMT to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms up. If the

plug-bumping failed, pressure test 9-5/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 3,000 psi/30mins @

1.20sg mud, record the results in DDR.

2) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD @ 3141 m MD RKB. Take survey every

200-400 m.

3) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again.

4) Drop Multi shot and POOH.

5) Perform wireline logging as per logging program.

6) Run 5" DP to 3130m and circulate the holeclean and set cement plug about 350m of

length which should from the Bottom of S5 to the Top of S1. The depth will be confirm

with RE in order to seal off the waterleg of Sarvak.

7) POOH to 2750m, circulate the hole clean and set 5m3 Hi-vis drill fluid at bottom.

8) POOH to 2710m, circulate the hole clean and set cement plug about 200m of length.

9) POOH to 2480m and circulate the hole clean.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 12

10) WOC 24h or the surface cement sample become hard. At the same time, POOH to

Surface and RIH cleanup BHA to 2480m+/-.

11) RIH the cleanup BHA (or Directional drilling BHA) to tag TOC. Drill the cement plug

to 2610m the depth of sidetrack, Do cement hardness test (the cement can stand 15T), if

meet the need for sidetrack, POOH. Otherwise, drill the plug to 2650m +/-, POOH and

Do Cement plug operation again.

Note:

a) If the directional drilling BHA was run to drill the cement plug and the cement plug

situation meet the requirement of Sidetrack, Continue to do sidetrack operation after drilling the

cement to KOP.

b) If updated KOP is deviated from ±100m as this program, real time program can be

prevailed as a executive plan for directional

8.4 Drill 8-1/2" Horizontal Section (2610-4140.42m (MD))

1) RIH the build-up BHA to the sidetrack depth, side drill the directional hole form the

pilot hole.

2) Directional drill to the end of first build-up section and make sure this depth is about

30m (TVD) above S1 or when drill into the Lafan formation, POOH and change from

MWD to LWD.

3) Continuing directional drill to target A, then POOH change Build-up BHA to holding

BHA.

4) Continuing directional drill to TD.

5) The directional well engineer will decide to adjust the borehole trajectory scheme

according to changes of the borehole trajectory. Drill the hold-on section with the single

bending screw of combination drilling method. Adjust the drilling method and control

changes of the deviation and azimuth according to inclination survey data from time to

time, so as to ensure the trajectory is smooth.

6) For kick-off section and hold-on section, MWD/LWD is adopted for deviated well

section survey. If the borehole trajectory is greatly deviated from the design trajectory,

it is necessary to enhance the frequency of inclination survey and adopt measures in

time.

7) Control the drilling speed to avoid pressure surge and stabilize the borehole wall. Adjust

mud properties according to the drilling design and borehole conditions

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 13

8) For build-up section the survey interval is no more than 10m, for holding section and

horizontal section the survey interval is no more than 30m.

9) After drill to TD, circulate at least 1 bottom up, wiper trip to casing shoe and RIH to

150m below Target A, Spot hi-vis pill at 100m length below Target A.

10) POOH to Target A, circulate to clean the hole, spot lubricant pill to KOP, POOH.

11) RIH 9-5/8" scraper for setting 7" liner hanger, POOH.

12) Run 7" liner as per tally, set liner hanger, cement 7" liner. If the cementing plug is

bumping, increases 500psi than final displacement pump-pressure. POOH. WOC.

13) Run 8-1/2" cleanup BHA &amp;amp; drilled out the cement, if any, to top of 7" liner hanger,

POOH.

14) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Top cement

plug in 7" liner and RIH to 3100m(the inclination not less than 60°).

15) POOH and Perform CBL/VDL logging in 7" liner for the interval where inclination is

less than 60°.

16) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Bottom

cement plug in 7" liner

17) Before drill to landing collar, pressure test to 3000psi with mud.

18) Drill out cement and RIH to TD. Circulate the horizontal hole clean.

19) Displace 1.15±0.05SG Mud below Target A.

20) POOH to 7” casing shoe, circulated with 1.32±0.02SG Mud.

21) RIH 7" scraper to scrape the interval for setting 4-1/2" liner hanger and 7" production

packer.

22) Run 4-1/2" slotted liner as per casing tally.

23) Set the liner hanger &amp;amp; release running tool.

24) Before pick up the running tool, pump 2m3 spacer fluids, pick up one stand and then

displace original mud with completion fluid reversely.

25) POOH the running tool to surface.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 14

9 Completion

9.1 Run completion string

1) P/U &amp;amp; M/U 3-1/2 mule shoe, shear out ball seat, selective landing nipple w/no-go,

retrievable hydraulic set production packer, keyed travel joint, injection subs, landing

nipple, SSD(keep close), side pocket mandrels with dummy valve and TRSCSSSV as

the below schematic.

2) When M/U chemical injection subs, connect 3/8" injection line to chemical injection

sub, and hold pressure in the line to RIH.

3) Install injection line protector across tubing coupling during RIH.

4) Drift the tubing and pressure test each 1000m.

5) Keep the SSD closed during RIH.

6) When run SPM, the dummy valve should be installed at surface.

7) When M/U TRSCSSSV, install ¼" control line to TRSCSSSV and pressure test control

line. Keep pressure applied to ensure TRSCSSSV open. Install TRSCSSSV protector

for the injection line &amp;amp; control line.

8) Reverse-circulate 1 round when completion strings run to bottom.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 16

9.2 Space out

1) Space out as required with pup joints, to sting mule shoe into 4-1/2" liner hanger 2m±.

2) Pick up &amp;amp; M/U tubing hanger with double pin crossover. M/U landing joint.

3) Cut control line and injection line about 2-3m above tubing hanger, wrap the lines

below the tubing hanger and feed control line &amp;amp; injection line through hanger.

9.3 Run Gauge Cutter

1) Rig up the slick line unit.

2) Open TRSCSSSV.

3) Drift wellbore to 2900m (≤45º) with gauge cutter which OD is 2.8". POOH.

4) R/D slickline unit.

9.4 Land tubing hanger

1) Land tubing hanger into tubing head spool.

2) Lock all tie-down bolts.

3) Close variable Pipe Ram BOP.

4) Open gate valves on tubing head spool.

5) Pressure to 5000psi /15min in annulus through kill manifold to test Tubing Hanger Seal,

observe any pressure loss.

6) Monitor if any fluid leak from gate valve.

9.5 Set production packer

1) Drop ball into tubing.

2) Pump the ball to ball seat.

3) Pump pressure to 4600psi to set packer.

4) Close annular BOP. Pump 3000psi from annulus to verify the packer setting. Bleed off

pressure slowly.

5) Pump pressure to 5000psi to shear the ball seat.

6) Land down landing joint.

9.6 N/D BOP and N/U X-mas tree

1) Set BPV

2) N/D bell nipple and BOP stack.

3) N/U tree adapter and X-mas tree.

4) Feed control line and CILs and cable through tree bonnet, install fittings and needle

valves. Pressure test control line 5000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero. Pressure

test CIL 2000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 17

5) Retrieve BPV and install TWCV.

6) Pressure test tree adapter cavity with test pump to 300psi/5mins, 5,000psi/15mins.

Pressure tests the X-mas tree body to 300psi/5 mins, 5,000psi/15 mins.

7) Function test SSV actuator.

8) Pull out TWCV.

9) R/U Lubricator. Pressure test lubricator to 5000psi.

10) Run slickline tools to open SSD.

11) Displace completion fluid with water in tubing and diesel in annular above SSD.

12) Close SSD.

13) Pump pressure (Annulus) to 3000psi to test SSD.

9.7 Rig move

1) Close swab valve &amp;amp;wing gate valves on sides, open upper master valve, lower master

valve and SSV above master valve.

2) Open SCSSSV.

3) Record SIWHP.

4) Bleed off control line pressure to close TRSCSSSV.

5) Bleed off WHP, and measure return. And observe WHP for 30 min, if pressure is

positive, remedial plan will be discussed.

6) Install BPV.

7) Close upper master valve. And keep gate wing valves in close position.

8) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

9) Rig down and move out. Any damage to the X-tree will be forbidden during rig down

and move.

9.8 Clean up test

1) Retrieve BPV.

2) Open adjustable choke slowly to flow-back the well, if can’t flow back naturally,

nitrogen or fresh water will be considered to inject by CTU.

9.9 Acidizing

Reservoir and production departments will decide when or whether perform the acidizing job.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 18

9.10 Flow test and build up test

As requested by reservoir and production do the flow test and build up test.

9.11 Suspend well till Production

1) Bullhead diesel to the bottom.

2) Close TRSCSSV. Open choke manifold and bleed off pressure above TRSCSSV slowly

to zero, record return fluid(diesel) volume, close choke manifold and monitor WHP

build up for 30 min, if no pressure to build up, go to the next step, otherwise, find reason

and take remedial measure.

3) Install BPV after inflow done.

4) Close swab valve and upper master valve &amp;amp; SSV.

5) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

6) Wrap vale stem and need vale.

The well status and each valve position on wellhead and X-mas tree during shut-in period

shall be as following.

Table-7 valve status during suspension

Note: completion operation will be adjusted properly based on the formal production

strategy and plan from production and reservoir departments.

11 Well Control Requirements

Drilling contractor must strictly follow IPS, Drilling Operations Manual (YAP1-GGGGGGDRDE-MAOP-1002-G01), Well Control Manual (YAP1-GGGGGG-DRDE-MAWC-1001-

G00), SIPC petroleum and natural gas industry standards 《 Well control Technique

Specification for Well Drilling》 , SY/ T6426-2005 and《Well Control Equipment Match,

Fixing and Maintenance》 , SY/ T5964-2006.

11.1 Well Control during POOH, RIH and Wire-line Logging

The well control while running, pull drill pipe and wire-line logging is important and

critical, best practices shall be followed, including but not limited to:

 Wipe trip and flow check before pull out drill pipe, monitor holes condition by trip tank

during all of the drilling process.

 Control running drill pipe speed to avoid any risk of losing in weakness formation.

 Wire-line BOP should available in wire-line logging operation.

11.2 Well Control during Running Casing

The well control while running casing is important and critical, best practices shall be

followed, including but not limited to:

 Change out pipe size rams with casing size rams prior to running 7"liner for expected

hydrocarbon bearing formation.

 The crossover for casing connection to drill pipe must available on floor. A good

practice is to keep a joint of DP with casing crossover at lower end and full opened

safety valve at upper end to be ready for picking up on V-door.

11.3 Requirements of weighting material storage

Barite should be used as weighting material. The stimulation will be conducted to reduce the

affection of Barite to the reservoir.

The kill fluid should be prepared before spud in, and settling stability should be less than

0.03 g/cm3. The kill fluid density should be increased if the active mud weight changes.

8 Drilling Operation Procedure

8.1 Preparation and Drill 17-1/2" Hole Section (22-300m)

1) The 20"SOL X 21-1/4"2K should be installed before spud as Wellhead engineer

recommends. And install 21-1/4"2k upper flange welded 20" casing nipple on the

wellhead.

 M/U 1 stand DP +26" Bit to sweep the soil in 30” conductor and drill to about

24m (a joint 20"casing below the cellar bottom).

 POOH and run 20" casing string to bottom and space out the 20" SOL x 21-

1/4"2k wellhead as required .

 Cement the annular between 30" conductor and 20" casing.

 Cut the 30" conductor and 20" casing as required, grind the top end of 20"casing

and 30"conductor, install the 20" SOL x 21-1/4"2k wellhead and Bowl protector.

 Install a 21-1/4" 2k upper flange welded and bell nipple.

1) Drill the first and second stands to avoid washing out the conductor. Pump Hi-Vis pill to

sweep hole when every stand drills down.

2) Go on drilling to section TD 300 m.

3) Wiper trip should be conducted 150-200m or as per hole condition.

4) POOH to surface and run back to bottom, circulation again.

5) Pump Hi-Vis pill. Circulate hole clean. Drop single shot survey Tool.

6) POOH to surface, retrieve single shot Tool.

7) Run 13-3/8" casing as per casing tally. Set the 13-3/8" casing hanger in 21-1/4" 2K

casing head, but release the hang weight of the casing not more than 1ton to prevent the

20" conductor sink in the earth, the hook must hang the other weight of the casing string.

8) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 2000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

9) WOC. N/U 21-1/4" × 13-5/8" casing head. N/U BOP stack and Conduct BOP and

casing head Pressure test.

8.2 Drill 12-1/4" Hole Section (300-1562m)

1) RIH BHA with PDC to tag TOC. Drill cement to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms

up.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 11

2) Add NMDC in BHA, in order to do multi shot survey operation for this section.

3) If the plug-bumping failed, pressure test 13-3/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 2,000

psi/30mins @ 1.10sg mud, record the results in DDR.

4) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD@1562m as per drilling parameters. Take

survey every 200-400 m.

5) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again. Drop

Multi shot and POOH.

6) Run 9-5/8" casing as per casing tally. Casing specification and Centralizers Placement

as per cementing program.

7) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 3000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

8) WOC. N/D BOP, N/U 13-5/8" × 11" × 5 K casing head. N/U BOP stack, BOP and

casing head pressure test.

8.3 Drill 8-1/2" Pilot Hole Section (1562-3141m)

1) RIH to tag TOC carefully. Drill CMT to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms up. If the

plug-bumping failed, pressure test 9-5/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 3,000 psi/30mins @

1.20sg mud, record the results in DDR.

2) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD @ 3141 m MD RKB. Take survey every

200-400 m.

3) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again.

4) Drop Multi shot and POOH.

5) Perform wireline logging as per logging program.

6) Run 5" DP to 3130m and circulate the holeclean and set cement plug about 350m of

length which should from the Bottom of S5 to the Top of S1. The depth will be confirm

with RE in order to seal off the waterleg of Sarvak.

7) POOH to 2750m, circulate the hole clean and set 5m3 Hi-vis drill fluid at bottom.

8) POOH to 2710m, circulate the hole clean and set cement plug about 200m of length.

9) POOH to 2480m and circulate the hole clean.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 12

10) WOC 24h or the surface cement sample become hard. At the same time, POOH to

Surface and RIH cleanup BHA to 2480m+/-.

11) RIH the cleanup BHA (or Directional drilling BHA) to tag TOC. Drill the cement plug

to 2610m the depth of sidetrack, Do cement hardness test (the cement can stand 15T), if

meet the need for sidetrack, POOH. Otherwise, drill the plug to 2650m +/-, POOH and

Do Cement plug operation again.

Note:

a) If the directional drilling BHA was run to drill the cement plug and the cement plug

situation meet the requirement of Sidetrack, Continue to do sidetrack operation after drilling the

cement to KOP.

b) If updated KOP is deviated from ±100m as this program, real time program can be

prevailed as a executive plan for directional

8.4 Drill 8-1/2" Horizontal Section (2610-4140.42m (MD))

1) RIH the build-up BHA to the sidetrack depth, side drill the directional hole form the

pilot hole.

2) Directional drill to the end of first build-up section and make sure this depth is about

30m (TVD) above S1 or when drill into the Lafan formation, POOH and change from

MWD to LWD.

3) Continuing directional drill to target A, then POOH change Build-up BHA to holding

BHA.

4) Continuing directional drill to TD.

5) The directional well engineer will decide to adjust the borehole trajectory scheme

according to changes of the borehole trajectory. Drill the hold-on section with the single

bending screw of combination drilling method. Adjust the drilling method and control

changes of the deviation and azimuth according to inclination survey data from time to

time, so as to ensure the trajectory is smooth.

6) For kick-off section and hold-on section, MWD/LWD is adopted for deviated well

section survey. If the borehole trajectory is greatly deviated from the design trajectory,

it is necessary to enhance the frequency of inclination survey and adopt measures in

time.

7) Control the drilling speed to avoid pressure surge and stabilize the borehole wall. Adjust

mud properties according to the drilling design and borehole conditions

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 13

8) For build-up section the survey interval is no more than 10m, for holding section and

horizontal section the survey interval is no more than 30m.

9) After drill to TD, circulate at least 1 bottom up, wiper trip to casing shoe and RIH to

150m below Target A, Spot hi-vis pill at 100m length below Target A.

10) POOH to Target A, circulate to clean the hole, spot lubricant pill to KOP, POOH.

11) RIH 9-5/8" scraper for setting 7" liner hanger, POOH.

12) Run 7" liner as per tally, set liner hanger, cement 7" liner. If the cementing plug is

bumping, increases 500psi than final displacement pump-pressure. POOH. WOC.

13) Run 8-1/2" cleanup BHA &amp;amp; drilled out the cement, if any, to top of 7" liner hanger,

POOH.

14) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Top cement

plug in 7" liner and RIH to 3100m(the inclination not less than 60°).

15) POOH and Perform CBL/VDL logging in 7" liner for the interval where inclination is

less than 60°.

16) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Bottom

cement plug in 7" liner

17) Before drill to landing collar, pressure test to 3000psi with mud.

18) Drill out cement and RIH to TD. Circulate the horizontal hole clean.

19) Displace 1.15±0.05SG Mud below Target A.

20) POOH to 7” casing shoe, circulated with 1.32±0.02SG Mud.

21) RIH 7" scraper to scrape the interval for setting 4-1/2" liner hanger and 7" production

packer.

22) Run 4-1/2" slotted liner as per casing tally.

23) Set the liner hanger &amp;amp; release running tool.

24) Before pick up the running tool, pump 2m3 spacer fluids, pick up one stand and then

displace original mud with completion fluid reversely.

25) POOH the running tool to surface.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 14

9 Completion

9.1 Run completion string

1) P/U &amp;amp; M/U 3-1/2 mule shoe, shear out ball seat, selective landing nipple w/no-go,

retrievable hydraulic set production packer, keyed travel joint, injection subs, landing

nipple, SSD(keep close), side pocket mandrels with dummy valve and TRSCSSSV as

the below schematic.

2) When M/U chemical injection subs, connect 3/8" injection line to chemical injection

sub, and hold pressure in the line to RIH.

3) Install injection line protector across tubing coupling during RIH.

4) Drift the tubing and pressure test each 1000m.

5) Keep the SSD closed during RIH.

6) When run SPM, the dummy valve should be installed at surface.

7) When M/U TRSCSSSV, install ¼" control line to TRSCSSSV and pressure test control

line. Keep pressure applied to ensure TRSCSSSV open. Install TRSCSSSV protector

for the injection line &amp;amp; control line.

8) Reverse-circulate 1 round when completion strings run to bottom.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 16

9.2 Space out

1) Space out as required with pup joints, to sting mule shoe into 4-1/2" liner hanger 2m±.

2) Pick up &amp;amp; M/U tubing hanger with double pin crossover. M/U landing joint.

3) Cut control line and injection line about 2-3m above tubing hanger, wrap the lines

below the tubing hanger and feed control line &amp;amp; injection line through hanger.

9.3 Run Gauge Cutter

1) Rig up the slick line unit.

2) Open TRSCSSSV.

3) Drift wellbore to 2900m (≤45º) with gauge cutter which OD is 2.8". POOH.

4) R/D slickline unit.

9.4 Land tubing hanger

1) Land tubing hanger into tubing head spool.

2) Lock all tie-down bolts.

3) Close variable Pipe Ram BOP.

4) Open gate valves on tubing head spool.

5) Pressure to 5000psi /15min in annulus through kill manifold to test Tubing Hanger Seal,

observe any pressure loss.

6) Monitor if any fluid leak from gate valve.

9.5 Set production packer

1) Drop ball into tubing.

2) Pump the ball to ball seat.

3) Pump pressure to 4600psi to set packer.

4) Close annular BOP. Pump 3000psi from annulus to verify the packer setting. Bleed off

pressure slowly.

5) Pump pressure to 5000psi to shear the ball seat.

6) Land down landing joint.

9.6 N/D BOP and N/U X-mas tree

1) Set BPV

2) N/D bell nipple and BOP stack.

3) N/U tree adapter and X-mas tree.

4) Feed control line and CILs and cable through tree bonnet, install fittings and needle

valves. Pressure test control line 5000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero. Pressure

test CIL 2000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 17

5) Retrieve BPV and install TWCV.

6) Pressure test tree adapter cavity with test pump to 300psi/5mins, 5,000psi/15mins.

Pressure tests the X-mas tree body to 300psi/5 mins, 5,000psi/15 mins.

7) Function test SSV actuator.

8) Pull out TWCV.

9) R/U Lubricator. Pressure test lubricator to 5000psi.

10) Run slickline tools to open SSD.

11) Displace completion fluid with water in tubing and diesel in annular above SSD.

12) Close SSD.

13) Pump pressure (Annulus) to 3000psi to test SSD.

9.7 Rig move

1) Close swab valve &amp;amp;wing gate valves on sides, open upper master valve, lower master

valve and SSV above master valve.

2) Open SCSSSV.

3) Record SIWHP.

4) Bleed off control line pressure to close TRSCSSSV.

5) Bleed off WHP, and measure return. And observe WHP for 30 min, if pressure is

positive, remedial plan will be discussed.

6) Install BPV.

7) Close upper master valve. And keep gate wing valves in close position.

8) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

9) Rig down and move out. Any damage to the X-tree will be forbidden during rig down

and move.

9.8 Clean up test

1) Retrieve BPV.

2) Open adjustable choke slowly to flow-back the well, if can’t flow back naturally,

nitrogen or fresh water will be considered to inject by CTU.

9.9 Acidizing

Reservoir and production departments will decide when or whether perform the acidizing job.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 18

9.10 Flow test and build up test

As requested by reservoir and production do the flow test and build up test.

9.11 Suspend well till Production

1) Bullhead diesel to the bottom.

2) Close TRSCSSV. Open choke manifold and bleed off pressure above TRSCSSV slowly

to zero, record return fluid(diesel) volume, close choke manifold and monitor WHP

build up for 30 min, if no pressure to build up, go to the next step, otherwise, find reason

and take remedial measure.

3) Install BPV after inflow done.

4) Close swab valve and upper master valve &amp;amp; SSV.

5) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

6) Wrap vale stem and need vale.

The well status and each valve position on wellhead and X-mas tree during shut-in period

shall be as following.

Table-7 valve status during suspension

Note: completion operation will be adjusted properly based on the formal production

strategy and plan from production and reservoir departments.

11 Well Control Requirements

Drilling contractor must strictly follow IPS, Drilling Operations Manual (YAP1-GGGGGGDRDE-MAOP-1002-G01), Well Control Manual (YAP1-GGGGGG-DRDE-MAWC-1001-

G00), SIPC petroleum and natural gas industry standards 《 Well control Technique

Specification for Well Drilling》 , SY/ T6426-2005 and《Well Control Equipment Match,

Fixing and Maintenance》 , SY/ T5964-2006.

11.1 Well Control during POOH, RIH and Wire-line Logging

The well control while running, pull drill pipe and wire-line logging is important and

critical, best practices shall be followed, including but not limited to:

 Wipe trip and flow check before pull out drill pipe, monitor holes condition by trip tank

during all of the drilling process.

 Control running drill pipe speed to avoid any risk of losing in weakness formation.

 Wire-line BOP should available in wire-line logging operation.

11.2 Well Control during Running Casing

The well control while running casing is important and critical, best practices shall be

followed, including but not limited to:

 Change out pipe size rams with casing size rams prior to running 7"liner for expected

hydrocarbon bearing formation.

 The crossover for casing connection to drill pipe must available on floor. A good

practice is to keep a joint of DP with casing crossover at lower end and full opened

safety valve at upper end to be ready for picking up on V-door.

11.3 Requirements of weighting material storage

Barite should be used as weighting material. The stimulation will be conducted to reduce the

affection of Barite to the reservoir.

The kill fluid should be prepared before spud in, and settling stability should be less than

0.03 g/cm3. The kill fluid density should be increased if the active mud weight changes.

8 Drilling Operation Procedure

8.1 Preparation and Drill 17-1/2" Hole Section (22-300m)

1) The 20"SOL X 21-1/4"2K should be installed before spud as Wellhead engineer

recommends. And install 21-1/4"2k upper flange welded 20" casing nipple on the

wellhead.

 M/U 1 stand DP +26" Bit to sweep the soil in 30” conductor and drill to about

24m (a joint 20"casing below the cellar bottom).

 POOH and run 20" casing string to bottom and space out the 20" SOL x 21-

1/4"2k wellhead as required .

 Cement the annular between 30" conductor and 20" casing.

 Cut the 30" conductor and 20" casing as required, grind the top end of 20"casing

and 30"conductor, install the 20" SOL x 21-1/4"2k wellhead and Bowl protector.

 Install a 21-1/4" 2k upper flange welded and bell nipple.

1) Drill the first and second stands to avoid washing out the conductor. Pump Hi-Vis pill to

sweep hole when every stand drills down.

2) Go on drilling to section TD 300 m.

3) Wiper trip should be conducted 150-200m or as per hole condition.

4) POOH to surface and run back to bottom, circulation again.

5) Pump Hi-Vis pill. Circulate hole clean. Drop single shot survey Tool.

6) POOH to surface, retrieve single shot Tool.

7) Run 13-3/8" casing as per casing tally. Set the 13-3/8" casing hanger in 21-1/4" 2K

casing head, but release the hang weight of the casing not more than 1ton to prevent the

20" conductor sink in the earth, the hook must hang the other weight of the casing string.

8) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 2000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

9) WOC. N/U 21-1/4" × 13-5/8" casing head. N/U BOP stack and Conduct BOP and

casing head Pressure test.

8.2 Drill 12-1/4" Hole Section (300-1562m)

1) RIH BHA with PDC to tag TOC. Drill cement to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms

up.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 11

2) Add NMDC in BHA, in order to do multi shot survey operation for this section.

3) If the plug-bumping failed, pressure test 13-3/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 2,000

psi/30mins @ 1.10sg mud, record the results in DDR.

4) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD@1562m as per drilling parameters. Take

survey every 200-400 m.

5) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again. Drop

Multi shot and POOH.

6) Run 9-5/8" casing as per casing tally. Casing specification and Centralizers Placement

as per cementing program.

7) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 3000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

8) WOC. N/D BOP, N/U 13-5/8" × 11" × 5 K casing head. N/U BOP stack, BOP and

casing head pressure test.

8.3 Drill 8-1/2" Pilot Hole Section (1562-3141m)

1) RIH to tag TOC carefully. Drill CMT to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms up. If the

plug-bumping failed, pressure test 9-5/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 3,000 psi/30mins @

1.20sg mud, record the results in DDR.

2) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD @ 3141 m MD RKB. Take survey every

200-400 m.

3) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again.

4) Drop Multi shot and POOH.

5) Perform wireline logging as per logging program.

6) Run 5" DP to 3130m and circulate the holeclean and set cement plug about 350m of

length which should from the Bottom of S5 to the Top of S1. The depth will be confirm

with RE in order to seal off the waterleg of Sarvak.

7) POOH to 2750m, circulate the hole clean and set 5m3 Hi-vis drill fluid at bottom.

8) POOH to 2710m, circulate the hole clean and set cement plug about 200m of length.

9) POOH to 2480m and circulate the hole clean.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 12

10) WOC 24h or the surface cement sample become hard. At the same time, POOH to

Surface and RIH cleanup BHA to 2480m+/-.

11) RIH the cleanup BHA (or Directional drilling BHA) to tag TOC. Drill the cement plug

to 2610m the depth of sidetrack, Do cement hardness test (the cement can stand 15T), if

meet the need for sidetrack, POOH. Otherwise, drill the plug to 2650m +/-, POOH and

Do Cement plug operation again.

Note:

a) If the directional drilling BHA was run to drill the cement plug and the cement plug

situation meet the requirement of Sidetrack, Continue to do sidetrack operation after drilling the

cement to KOP.

b) If updated KOP is deviated from ±100m as this program, real time program can be

prevailed as a executive plan for directional

8.4 Drill 8-1/2" Horizontal Section (2610-4140.42m (MD))

1) RIH the build-up BHA to the sidetrack depth, side drill the directional hole form the

pilot hole.

2) Directional drill to the end of first build-up section and make sure this depth is about

30m (TVD) above S1 or when drill into the Lafan formation, POOH and change from

MWD to LWD.

3) Continuing directional drill to target A, then POOH change Build-up BHA to holding

BHA.

4) Continuing directional drill to TD.

5) The directional well engineer will decide to adjust the borehole trajectory scheme

according to changes of the borehole trajectory. Drill the hold-on section with the single

bending screw of combination drilling method. Adjust the drilling method and control

changes of the deviation and azimuth according to inclination survey data from time to

time, so as to ensure the trajectory is smooth.

6) For kick-off section and hold-on section, MWD/LWD is adopted for deviated well

section survey. If the borehole trajectory is greatly deviated from the design trajectory,

it is necessary to enhance the frequency of inclination survey and adopt measures in

time.

7) Control the drilling speed to avoid pressure surge and stabilize the borehole wall. Adjust

mud properties according to the drilling design and borehole conditions

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 13

8) For build-up section the survey interval is no more than 10m, for holding section and

horizontal section the survey interval is no more than 30m.

9) After drill to TD, circulate at least 1 bottom up, wiper trip to casing shoe and RIH to

150m below Target A, Spot hi-vis pill at 100m length below Target A.

10) POOH to Target A, circulate to clean the hole, spot lubricant pill to KOP, POOH.

11) RIH 9-5/8" scraper for setting 7" liner hanger, POOH.

12) Run 7" liner as per tally, set liner hanger, cement 7" liner. If the cementing plug is

bumping, increases 500psi than final displacement pump-pressure. POOH. WOC.

13) Run 8-1/2" cleanup BHA &amp;amp; drilled out the cement, if any, to top of 7" liner hanger,

POOH.

14) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Top cement

plug in 7" liner and RIH to 3100m(the inclination not less than 60°).

15) POOH and Perform CBL/VDL logging in 7" liner for the interval where inclination is

less than 60°.

16) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Bottom

cement plug in 7" liner

17) Before drill to landing collar, pressure test to 3000psi with mud.

18) Drill out cement and RIH to TD. Circulate the horizontal hole clean.

19) Displace 1.15±0.05SG Mud below Target A.

20) POOH to 7” casing shoe, circulated with 1.32±0.02SG Mud.

21) RIH 7" scraper to scrape the interval for setting 4-1/2" liner hanger and 7" production

packer.

22) Run 4-1/2" slotted liner as per casing tally.

23) Set the liner hanger &amp;amp; release running tool.

24) Before pick up the running tool, pump 2m3 spacer fluids, pick up one stand and then

displace original mud with completion fluid reversely.

25) POOH the running tool to surface.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 14

9 Completion

9.1 Run completion string

1) P/U &amp;amp; M/U 3-1/2 mule shoe, shear out ball seat, selective landing nipple w/no-go,

retrievable hydraulic set production packer, keyed travel joint, injection subs, landing

nipple, SSD(keep close), side pocket mandrels with dummy valve and TRSCSSSV as

the below schematic.

2) When M/U chemical injection subs, connect 3/8" injection line to chemical injection

sub, and hold pressure in the line to RIH.

3) Install injection line protector across tubing coupling during RIH.

4) Drift the tubing and pressure test each 1000m.

5) Keep the SSD closed during RIH.

6) When run SPM, the dummy valve should be installed at surface.

7) When M/U TRSCSSSV, install ¼" control line to TRSCSSSV and pressure test control

line. Keep pressure applied to ensure TRSCSSSV open. Install TRSCSSSV protector

for the injection line &amp;amp; control line.

8) Reverse-circulate 1 round when completion strings run to bottom.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 16

9.2 Space out

1) Space out as required with pup joints, to sting mule shoe into 4-1/2" liner hanger 2m±.

2) Pick up &amp;amp; M/U tubing hanger with double pin crossover. M/U landing joint.

3) Cut control line and injection line about 2-3m above tubing hanger, wrap the lines

below the tubing hanger and feed control line &amp;amp; injection line through hanger.

9.3 Run Gauge Cutter

1) Rig up the slick line unit.

2) Open TRSCSSSV.

3) Drift wellbore to 2900m (≤45º) with gauge cutter which OD is 2.8". POOH.

4) R/D slickline unit.

9.4 Land tubing hanger

1) Land tubing hanger into tubing head spool.

2) Lock all tie-down bolts.

3) Close variable Pipe Ram BOP.

4) Open gate valves on tubing head spool.

5) Pressure to 5000psi /15min in annulus through kill manifold to test Tubing Hanger Seal,

observe any pressure loss.

6) Monitor if any fluid leak from gate valve.

9.5 Set production packer

1) Drop ball into tubing.

2) Pump the ball to ball seat.

3) Pump pressure to 4600psi to set packer.

4) Close annular BOP. Pump 3000psi from annulus to verify the packer setting. Bleed off

pressure slowly.

5) Pump pressure to 5000psi to shear the ball seat.

6) Land down landing joint.

9.6 N/D BOP and N/U X-mas tree

1) Set BPV

2) N/D bell nipple and BOP stack.

3) N/U tree adapter and X-mas tree.

4) Feed control line and CILs and cable through tree bonnet, install fittings and needle

valves. Pressure test control line 5000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero. Pressure

test CIL 2000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 17

5) Retrieve BPV and install TWCV.

6) Pressure test tree adapter cavity with test pump to 300psi/5mins, 5,000psi/15mins.

Pressure tests the X-mas tree body to 300psi/5 mins, 5,000psi/15 mins.

7) Function test SSV actuator.

8) Pull out TWCV.

9) R/U Lubricator. Pressure test lubricator to 5000psi.

10) Run slickline tools to open SSD.

11) Displace completion fluid with water in tubing and diesel in annular above SSD.

12) Close SSD.

13) Pump pressure (Annulus) to 3000psi to test SSD.

9.7 Rig move

1) Close swab valve &amp;amp;wing gate valves on sides, open upper master valve, lower master

valve and SSV above master valve.

2) Open SCSSSV.

3) Record SIWHP.

4) Bleed off control line pressure to close TRSCSSSV.

5) Bleed off WHP, and measure return. And observe WHP for 30 min, if pressure is

positive, remedial plan will be discussed.

6) Install BPV.

7) Close upper master valve. And keep gate wing valves in close position.

8) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

9) Rig down and move out. Any damage to the X-tree will be forbidden during rig down

and move.

9.8 Clean up test

1) Retrieve BPV.

2) Open adjustable choke slowly to flow-back the well, if can’t flow back naturally,

nitrogen or fresh water will be considered to inject by CTU.

9.9 Acidizing

Reservoir and production departments will decide when or whether perform the acidizing job.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 18

9.10 Flow test and build up test

As requested by reservoir and production do the flow test and build up test.

9.11 Suspend well till Production

1) Bullhead diesel to the bottom.

2) Close TRSCSSV. Open choke manifold and bleed off pressure above TRSCSSV slowly

to zero, record return fluid(diesel) volume, close choke manifold and monitor WHP

build up for 30 min, if no pressure to build up, go to the next step, otherwise, find reason

and take remedial measure.

3) Install BPV after inflow done.

4) Close swab valve and upper master valve &amp;amp; SSV.

5) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

6) Wrap vale stem and need vale.

The well status and each valve position on wellhead and X-mas tree during shut-in period

shall be as following.

11 Well Control Requirements

Drilling contractor must strictly follow IPS, Drilling Operations Manual (YAP1-GGGGGGDRDE-MAOP-1002-G01), Well Control Manual (YAP1-GGGGGG-DRDE-MAWC-1001-

G00), SIPC petroleum and natural gas industry standards 《 Well control Technique

Specification for Well Drilling》 , SY/ T6426-2005 and《Well Control Equipment Match,

Fixing and Maintenance》 , SY/ T5964-2006.

11.1 Well Control during POOH, RIH and Wire-line Logging

The well control while running, pull drill pipe and wire-line logging is important and

critical, best practices shall be followed, including but not limited to:

 Wipe trip and flow check before pull out drill pipe, monitor holes condition by trip tank

during all of the drilling process.

 Control running drill pipe speed to avoid any risk of losing in weakness formation.

 Wire-line BOP should available in wire-line logging operation.

11.2 Well Control during Running Casing

The well control while running casing is important and critical, best practices shall be

followed, including but not limited to:

 Change out pipe size rams with casing size rams prior to running 7"liner for expected

hydrocarbon bearing formation.

 The crossover for casing connection to drill pipe must available on floor. A good

practice is to keep a joint of DP with casing crossover at lower end and full opened

safety valve at upper end to be ready for picking up on V-door.

11.3 Requirements of weighting material storage

Barite should be used as weighting material. The stimulation will be conducted to reduce the

affection of Barite to the reservoir.

The kill fluid should be prepared before spud in, and settling stability should be less than

0.03 g/cm3. The kill fluid density should be increased if the active mud weight changes.

8.1 Preparation and Drill 17-1/2" Hole Section (22-300m)

1) The 20"SOL X 21-1/4"2K should be installed before spud as Wellhead engineer

recommends. And install 21-1/4"2k upper flange welded 20" casing nipple on the

wellhead.

 M/U 1 stand DP +26" Bit to sweep the soil in 30” conductor and drill to about

24m (a joint 20"casing below the cellar bottom).

 POOH and run 20" casing string to bottom and space out the 20" SOL x 21-

1/4"2k wellhead as required .

 Cement the annular between 30" conductor and 20" casing.

 Cut the 30" conductor and 20" casing as required, grind the top end of 20"casing

and 30"conductor, install the 20" SOL x 21-1/4"2k wellhead and Bowl protector.

 Install a 21-1/4" 2k upper flange welded and bell nipple.

1) Drill the first and second stands to avoid washing out the conductor. Pump Hi-Vis pill to

sweep hole when every stand drills down.

2) Go on drilling to section TD 300 m.

3) Wiper trip should be conducted 150-200m or as per hole condition.

4) POOH to surface and run back to bottom, circulation again.

5) Pump Hi-Vis pill. Circulate hole clean. Drop single shot survey Tool.

6) POOH to surface, retrieve single shot Tool.

7) Run 13-3/8" casing as per casing tally. Set the 13-3/8" casing hanger in 21-1/4" 2K

casing head, but release the hang weight of the casing not more than 1ton to prevent the

20" conductor sink in the earth, the hook must hang the other weight of the casing string.

8) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 2000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

9) WOC. N/U 21-1/4" × 13-5/8" casing head. N/U BOP stack and Conduct BOP and

casing head Pressure test.

8.2 Drill 12-1/4" Hole Section (300-1562m)

1) RIH BHA with PDC to tag TOC. Drill cement to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms

up.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 11

2) Add NMDC in BHA, in order to do multi shot survey operation for this section.

3) If the plug-bumping failed, pressure test 13-3/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 2,000

psi/30mins @ 1.10sg mud, record the results in DDR.

4) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD@1562m as per drilling parameters. Take

survey every 200-400 m.

5) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again. Drop

Multi shot and POOH.

6) Run 9-5/8" casing as per casing tally. Casing specification and Centralizers Placement

as per cementing program.

7) Conduct cementing job as per cementing program. If the cementing plug is bumping,

increases pump pressure to 3000 psi (Green Pressure Test).

8) WOC. N/D BOP, N/U 13-5/8" × 11" × 5 K casing head. N/U BOP stack, BOP and

casing head pressure test.

8.3 Drill 8-1/2" Pilot Hole Section (1562-3141m)

1) RIH to tag TOC carefully. Drill CMT to top of float collar. Circulate bottoms up. If the

plug-bumping failed, pressure test 9-5/8" casing to 300psi/5mins &amp;amp; 3,000 psi/30mins @

1.20sg mud, record the results in DDR.

2) Drill with KCl-Polymer mud to section TD @ 3141 m MD RKB. Take survey every

200-400 m.

3) Wipe trip every 200-400m or according to hole condition, drill to TD, wiper trip and

circulation. POOH to last casing shoe and run back to bottom, circulation again.

4) Drop Multi shot and POOH.

5) Perform wireline logging as per logging program.

6) Run 5" DP to 3130m and circulate the holeclean and set cement plug about 350m of

length which should from the Bottom of S5 to the Top of S1. The depth will be confirm

with RE in order to seal off the waterleg of Sarvak.

7) POOH to 2750m, circulate the hole clean and set 5m3 Hi-vis drill fluid at bottom.

8) POOH to 2710m, circulate the hole clean and set cement plug about 200m of length.

9) POOH to 2480m and circulate the hole clean.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 12

10) WOC 24h or the surface cement sample become hard. At the same time, POOH to

Surface and RIH cleanup BHA to 2480m+/-.

11) RIH the cleanup BHA (or Directional drilling BHA) to tag TOC. Drill the cement plug

to 2610m the depth of sidetrack, Do cement hardness test (the cement can stand 15T), if

meet the need for sidetrack, POOH. Otherwise, drill the plug to 2650m +/-, POOH and

Do Cement plug operation again.

Note:

a) If the directional drilling BHA was run to drill the cement plug and the cement plug

situation meet the requirement of Sidetrack, Continue to do sidetrack operation after drilling the

cement to KOP.

b) If updated KOP is deviated from ±100m as this program, real time program can be

prevailed as a executive plan for directional

8.4 Drill 8-1/2" Horizontal Section (2610-4140.42m (MD))

1) RIH the build-up BHA to the sidetrack depth, side drill the directional hole form the

pilot hole.

2) Directional drill to the end of first build-up section and make sure this depth is about

30m (TVD) above S1 or when drill into the Lafan formation, POOH and change from

MWD to LWD.

3) Continuing directional drill to target A, then POOH change Build-up BHA to holding

BHA.

4) Continuing directional drill to TD.

5) The directional well engineer will decide to adjust the borehole trajectory scheme

according to changes of the borehole trajectory. Drill the hold-on section with the single

bending screw of combination drilling method. Adjust the drilling method and control

changes of the deviation and azimuth according to inclination survey data from time to

time, so as to ensure the trajectory is smooth.

6) For kick-off section and hold-on section, MWD/LWD is adopted for deviated well

section survey. If the borehole trajectory is greatly deviated from the design trajectory,

it is necessary to enhance the frequency of inclination survey and adopt measures in

time.

7) Control the drilling speed to avoid pressure surge and stabilize the borehole wall. Adjust

mud properties according to the drilling design and borehole conditions

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 13

8) For build-up section the survey interval is no more than 10m, for holding section and

horizontal section the survey interval is no more than 30m.

9) After drill to TD, circulate at least 1 bottom up, wiper trip to casing shoe and RIH to

150m below Target A, Spot hi-vis pill at 100m length below Target A.

10) POOH to Target A, circulate to clean the hole, spot lubricant pill to KOP, POOH.

11) RIH 9-5/8" scraper for setting 7" liner hanger, POOH.

12) Run 7" liner as per tally, set liner hanger, cement 7" liner. If the cementing plug is

bumping, increases 500psi than final displacement pump-pressure. POOH. WOC.

13) Run 8-1/2" cleanup BHA &amp;amp; drilled out the cement, if any, to top of 7" liner hanger,

POOH.

14) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Top cement

plug in 7" liner and RIH to 3100m(the inclination not less than 60°).

15) POOH and Perform CBL/VDL logging in 7" liner for the interval where inclination is

less than 60°.

16) RIH with BHA (5-7/8" bit + 4-3/4"DC*3+3-1/2"HWDP+3-1/2"DP), drill Bottom

cement plug in 7" liner

17) Before drill to landing collar, pressure test to 3000psi with mud.

18) Drill out cement and RIH to TD. Circulate the horizontal hole clean.

19) Displace 1.15±0.05SG Mud below Target A.

20) POOH to 7” casing shoe, circulated with 1.32±0.02SG Mud.

21) RIH 7" scraper to scrape the interval for setting 4-1/2" liner hanger and 7" production

packer.

22) Run 4-1/2" slotted liner as per casing tally.

23) Set the liner hanger &amp;amp; release running tool.

24) Before pick up the running tool, pump 2m3 spacer fluids, pick up one stand and then

displace original mud with completion fluid reversely.

25) POOH the running tool to surface.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 14

9 Completion

9.1 Run completion string

1) P/U &amp;amp; M/U 3-1/2 mule shoe, shear out ball seat, selective landing nipple w/no-go,

retrievable hydraulic set production packer, keyed travel joint, injection subs, landing

nipple, SSD(keep close), side pocket mandrels with dummy valve and TRSCSSSV as

the below schematic.

2) When M/U chemical injection subs, connect 3/8" injection line to chemical injection

sub, and hold pressure in the line to RIH.

3) Install injection line protector across tubing coupling during RIH.

4) Drift the tubing and pressure test each 1000m.

5) Keep the SSD closed during RIH.

6) When run SPM, the dummy valve should be installed at surface.

7) When M/U TRSCSSSV, install ¼" control line to TRSCSSSV and pressure test control

line. Keep pressure applied to ensure TRSCSSSV open. Install TRSCSSSV protector

for the injection line &amp;amp; control line.

8) Reverse-circulate 1 round when completion strings run to bottom.

9.2 Space out

1) Space out as required with pup joints, to sting mule shoe into 4-1/2" liner hanger 2m±.

2) Pick up &amp;amp; M/U tubing hanger with double pin crossover. M/U landing joint.

3) Cut control line and injection line about 2-3m above tubing hanger, wrap the lines

below the tubing hanger and feed control line &amp;amp; injection line through hanger.

9.3 Run Gauge Cutter

1) Rig up the slick line unit.

2) Open TRSCSSSV.

3) Drift wellbore to 2900m (≤45º) with gauge cutter which OD is 2.8". POOH.

4) R/D slickline unit.

9.4 Land tubing hanger

1) Land tubing hanger into tubing head spool.

2) Lock all tie-down bolts.

3) Close variable Pipe Ram BOP.

4) Open gate valves on tubing head spool.

5) Pressure to 5000psi /15min in annulus through kill manifold to test Tubing Hanger Seal,

observe any pressure loss.

6) Monitor if any fluid leak from gate valve.

9.5 Set production packer

1) Drop ball into tubing.

2) Pump the ball to ball seat.

3) Pump pressure to 4600psi to set packer.

4) Close annular BOP. Pump 3000psi from annulus to verify the packer setting. Bleed off

pressure slowly.

5) Pump pressure to 5000psi to shear the ball seat.

6) Land down landing joint.

9.6 N/D BOP and N/U X-mas tree

1) Set BPV

2) N/D bell nipple and BOP stack.

3) N/U tree adapter and X-mas tree.

4) Feed control line and CILs and cable through tree bonnet, install fittings and needle

valves. Pressure test control line 5000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero. Pressure

test CIL 2000 psi/15 mins, bleed off pressure to zero.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 17

5) Retrieve BPV and install TWCV.

6) Pressure test tree adapter cavity with test pump to 300psi/5mins, 5,000psi/15mins.

Pressure tests the X-mas tree body to 300psi/5 mins, 5,000psi/15 mins.

7) Function test SSV actuator.

8) Pull out TWCV.

9) R/U Lubricator. Pressure test lubricator to 5000psi.

10) Run slickline tools to open SSD.

11) Displace completion fluid with water in tubing and diesel in annular above SSD.

12) Close SSD.

13) Pump pressure (Annulus) to 3000psi to test SSD.

9.7 Rig move

1) Close swab valve &amp;amp;wing gate valves on sides, open upper master valve, lower master

valve and SSV above master valve.

2) Open SCSSSV.

3) Record SIWHP.

4) Bleed off control line pressure to close TRSCSSSV.

5) Bleed off WHP, and measure return. And observe WHP for 30 min, if pressure is

positive, remedial plan will be discussed.

6) Install BPV.

7) Close upper master valve. And keep gate wing valves in close position.

8) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

9) Rig down and move out. Any damage to the X-tree will be forbidden during rig down

and move.

9.8 Clean up test

1) Retrieve BPV.

2) Open adjustable choke slowly to flow-back the well, if can’t flow back naturally,

nitrogen or fresh water will be considered to inject by CTU.

9.9 Acidizing

Reservoir and production departments will decide when or whether perform the acidizing job.

Drilling &amp;amp; Completion

Project Scope Displ. Doc. SEQ REV Page 18

9.10 Flow test and build up test

As requested by reservoir and production do the flow test and build up test.

9.11 Suspend well till Production

1) Bullhead diesel to the bottom.

2) Close TRSCSSV. Open choke manifold and bleed off pressure above TRSCSSV slowly

to zero, record return fluid(diesel) volume, close choke manifold and monitor WHP

build up for 30 min, if no pressure to build up, go to the next step, otherwise, find reason

and take remedial measure.

3) Install BPV after inflow done.

4) Close swab valve and upper master valve &amp;amp; SSV.

5) Check the annulus pressure; bleed off to zero if there is any.

6) Wrap vale stem and need vale.

The well status and each valve position on wellhead and X-mas tree during shut-in period

shall be as following.

Note: completion operation will be adjusted properly based on the formal production

strategy and plan from production and reservoir departments.

11 Well Control Requirements

Drilling contractor must strictly follow IPS, Drilling Operations Manual (YAP1-GGGGGGDRDE-MAOP-1002-G01), Well Control Manual (YAP1-GGGGGG-DRDE-MAWC-1001-

G00), SIPC petroleum and natural gas industry standards 《 Well control Technique

Specification for Well Drilling》 , SY/ T6426-2005 and《Well Control Equipment Match,

Fixing and Maintenance》 , SY/ T5964-2006.

11.1 Well Control during POOH, RIH and Wire-line Logging

The well control while running, pull drill pipe and wire-line logging is important and

critical, best practices shall be followed, including but not limited to:

 Wipe trip and flow check before pull out drill pipe, monitor holes condition by trip tank

during all of the drilling process.

 Control running drill pipe speed to avoid any risk of losing in weakness formation.

 Wire-line BOP should available in wire-line logging operation.

11.2 Well Control during Running Casing

The well control while running casing is important and critical, best practices shall be

followed, including but not limited to:

 Change out pipe size rams with casing size rams prior to running 7"liner for expected

hydrocarbon bearing formation.

 The crossover for casing connection to drill pipe must available on floor. A good

practice is to keep a joint of DP with casing crossover at lower end and full opened

safety valve at upper end to be ready for picking up on V-door.

11.3 Requirements of weighting material storage

Barite should be used as weighting material. The stimulation will be conducted to reduce the

affection of Barite to the reservoir.

The kill fluid should be prepared before spud in, and settling stability should be less than

0.03 g/cm3. The kill fluid density should be increased if the active mud weight changes.

مناقصه "طرح منصورآباد در قالب یک بسته یکپارچه از طرح عملیات محور

افزایش و نگهداشت تولید 27مخزن منتخب شرکت ملی مناطق نفتخیز جنوب"

شماره مناقصه: (م م/)97/0331

1 General Information

This Document Covers the Drilling of Asmari Producer Well in Mansur Abad Oilfield, Iran. These wells Shall Be Considered to Product from the Asmari Reservoir. There are totally six group with deferent combination of Producer and Delineation well and two categories of Vertical and Directional profile. In general, the 26” hole section will be drilled to 60 m and 18-5/8” casing set as Surface casing. Drilling in 17-1/2” hole section will be done to top of Gachsaran formation approximately +/- 1200m and will be cover by 13-3/8” Intermediate casing. The 12-1/4” hole section will be drilled at Gachsaran High pressure zone to Asmari Cap rock and then 9-5/8” Production casing will be run and cemented. the 8-1/2” hole section at reservoir zone will be different based on well objective and logging results . The 7” Liner will be run and finally Completion String will be run. Nipple up Well Head and Complete the Well.

This program covers the drilling of fourteen wells in Mansur Abad oil field, Iran. There are six types of well in this proposal.

1st group is including vertical wells with production goals from Asmari and delineation of oil – water contact at southern crest where the deep of layers are high. In this category there are two wells as below description:

- Location E 051 S as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location E 025.1 S as producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

2nd group is including vertical wells with production and delineation goals from Asmari structure in Western section of Mansur Abad oil field . The deep of layer at this area is normal. In this category there are four wells as below description:

- Location W 076 N as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari

reservoir

- Location E 010 N as producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location W 085 N as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari

reservoir

- Location W 061 N as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari

reservoir

3rd group is including vertical wells with production and delineation goals from Asmari structure in Eastern section of Mansur Abad oil field . The deep of layer at this area is mid to low angle. In this category there are five wells as below description:

- Location E 076 S as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location E 024 N as producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location E 064 N as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location E 047 S as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

- Location E 056 N as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari reservoir

4th group is including only one directional well to product from Asmari resevoir in Eastern section of Mansur Abad oil field . Drilling at location W 035 N will be started as vertically down to 450m (1st KOP). Drill the well directionally at the rate of 3.5º/100 ft down to M.B.U.A of 35º toward N179 º. Directional drilling will be continued at keep section (Constant angle and azimuth) down to top of Asmari formation (D.A.P). Dropping the well at the rate of 7º/100 ft down to vertical trajectory and continue to 20 m into Pabdeh formation.

- Location W 035 N as producer (directional) well from Asmari reservoir

5th group is including one vertical well for delineation and production of Asmari in Western section of Mansur Abad oil field where the deep of layers are high.

- Location W 026 S as delineation / producer (vertical) well from Asmari

reservoir

6th group is similar to 4th and including one directional well to delineate and product from Asmari structure in Western section of Mansur Abad oil field . Drilling at location W 029 N will be started as vertically down to 510m (1st KOP). Drill the well directionally at the rate of 2º/100 ft down to M.B.U.A of 31.5º toward N180º. Directional drilling will be continued at keep section (Constant angle and azimuth) down to top of Asmari formation (D.A.P). Dropping the well at the rate of 8º/100 ft down to vertical trajectory and continue to total depth of 3031 m ( -2400 m.s.s.d) in Pabdeh formation .

- Location W 029 N as delineation / producer (directional) well from Asmari

reservoir

1.2 Introduction

The Mansur Abad oil field is located in Khuzestan province, approximately 10 kilometers to the Northeast of Behbahan city. This Field is situated in an area which is known as Dezful Embayment. This structure is an elongated NW-SE trending anticline with approximately 600 Meters of closure at the Asmari level. It is measured about 3km by 21km, and is situated at South of Khaviz structure and is on the same trend structurally with Lishtar closure of Gachsaran oil field which is at southeast of Mansur Abad structure.

1.4 Well Objectives

The primary objectives of drilling the fourteen wells in Mansur Abad field are:

• To produce oil from Asmari reservoir.

• To develop the more information in Asmari Fm including:

- DST at the top 50m of Asmari Fm. in four wells such as : W076N (From 2000 to 2050 m.s.s.d),

W035N (From 1770 to 1820 m.s.s.d), W085N (From 1900 to 1950 m.s.s.d), W026S (From 1800 to 1850

m.s.s.d)

1.6 Final Target

As The Previous Exploration/Delineation Drilling in Mansur Abad Oil Field has Proved Presence of a Very Prolific Hydrocarbon Bearing Sedimentary Column, Particularly within the Cretaceous Sequences. The Asmari Formation is the Main Reservoir which is divided to 3 Zones (1, 2 &amp;amp;3). The Zones of Asmari are Oil Bearing with Tilted WOC.

The Objective For this Well will Be Interest Asmari 3&amp;amp;2&amp;amp;1 and Providing Maximum Drain Hole for Production.

1 Geological forecast

1.1 Formation Description

A brief description of the stratigraphic units expected to be drilled in Mansur Abad Formation typical vertical well has been presented in the following breakdown.

Mishan Formation

Mishan Formation mainly composed of grey marl and limestone. This formation in the lower part consists of a repetition of grey marl and boundstone.

Gachsaran Formation

Deposition of the Gachsaran Formation is cyclic. This formation totally consists of a repetition of Anhydrite, grey and red marl as well as salt and some limestone beds.

Asmari Formation

Asmari formation is predominantly composed of cream to light brown dolomite and Limestone. It is worth mentioning that due to Pyrnian orogeny, lower part of Asmari formation is not precipitated in Mansur Abad, Binak, Gulkhari, and Sulabedar oilfields.

Jahrum Formation

This formation mainly consists of limestone with interbedded of dolomite. There is not a sharp lithological boundary between Asmari formation and Jahrum formation but the top of this formation should be recognized by assemblage Zone 53.

Pabdeh Formation

At the beginning of this formation there are pyritic argillaceous brown, gray to brown and brown limestone and also there are layers of pyritic shale. At the base of this formation argillaceous limestone and gray marl with gluconate will be appear. There are some cherty zones in base of this formation.

Gurpi Formation

This formation mainly consists of gray marl and argillaceous pyritic limestone. At the base of this formation gray marls will be soft and sticky.

Ilam Formation

This formation consists of slightly pyritic light brown to white limestone which is very thinh (about 1.5m.) in Mansur Abad oilfield.

Sarvak Formation

Page 32

This formation consists of light gray to light brown, chalky, pyritic limestone with thin interbedded shale and argillaceous limestone.

Kazhdumi Formation

In top of this formation there is an alternation of calcareous shale and argillaceous limestone with interbedded sandy gray marl and green pyritic shale. This formation seems to be continued by light brown to white limestone. At the base of this formation, there are tongues of Burgan formation.

1.6 Coring Program

2 Program Outline

2.1 Drilling Summary

It is planned to drill and complete a typical well in Mansur Abad field to produce from Asmari reservoir.

26" Hole section:

The 26” Hole Section will be Drilled approximately 60 - 150 Mt through Mishan Formation. Mishan Formation Consists of A Marl, Sand-Shale. For Drilling This Section 65-67 pcf Pre-Hydrated Bentonite Mud will be used for Hole Cleaning. Also PHB Pill Will Be Used to Clean the Hole and Since Bentonite has the Best Cake around the Well Bore, It will make a Good Cake for Hole Stability. According to Previous Wells in this Field, this Section is almost Problem Free. The 18 5/8" conductor will be set at ± 60-150 Mt and it will be cemented in One Stage with Stinger (Exact CMT Program will be issued in Due Time). N/U 21-1/4" 2k C.H.H &amp;amp; 21 1/4" 2K Annular BOP and Single Rams.

17 ½” Hole section:

This Section will be drilled from ±60-150 Mt to ±1200 Mt through Mishan and Gachsaran formation. For Drilling This Section 75-95 Pcf Kcl/Nacl Polymer Mud will be Used. Also PHB Pill will be used to clean the Hole. CDR/GR log will be run in open hole. 13 3/8" Casing Shoe will Be Set at ±1200 Mt inside Gachsaran Formation. It will be cemented in One Stage (Lead &amp;amp; Tail - CMT Program will be issued in Due Time). N/Up

C.H.S 21-1/4" 2k x 13-5/8” 3K. N/U 13-5/8" 5K BOP’s Stack (13 5/8" 5K Annular Preventer + 13 5/8" 5K Double Rams + 13 5/8" 5K Single).

12 ¼" Hole Section:

This Section will be Drilled from ±1200 to ±2400-2700 through Gasharan formation to top of Asmari,. 105-125 Pcf Barite- Kcl Polymer Mud Will Be Used For Drilling This Section. Then 9 5/8” Caing will be Run ±2400-2700 Mt and Cemented in One Stage (Exact CMT Program will be issued in Due Time). CCL/GR/CBL-VDL Will Be Run after Perform 9 5/8” Cementing Job.

N/U T.H.S 13 5/8" 3k x 11" 5k. N/U 13-5/8” 5K BOP’s Stack. (13 5/8" 5k Annular BOP + 13 5/8" 5k Double Rams + 13 5/8" 5k Single).

8 ½” Hole Section :

This Section will be drilled from ±2400-2700 Mt to ±2700-3061 Mt (maximum ±20m inside top of Pabdeh formation) through Asmari reservoir Zone-1&amp;amp;2&amp;amp;3 by 55.5 - 62.4 Pcf OBM / Kcl Polymer Mud. The Risks of Drilling This Section is Drilling Fluid Loss, Tight Hole and Stuck Pipe Based on Offset Wells. The drilling sequence of this section will be illustrated by following:

1. Vertical drilling with the objective of getting Asmari formation at 2150m MSSD and

Continue drilling while coring from top of Zone-3 of Asmari Fm. to 2450 MSSD. Continue

vertical drilling to the final depth at 2650 MSSD.

2. Perform RFT from 2150 MSSD to 2650 MSSD. (there aren't this item in some wells)

3. Run full set reservoir log and image log from 2150 MSSD to 2650 MSSD. (the logging

intervals can be different based on well location of well in west or east section)

4. Plug the hole using cement plug at 2470 ± 50 MSSD

5. Place magneset plug at the depth based on log results (at about 2300 ± 150 MSSD)

6. Run 7” liner to the suitable depth based on log results at 2300 ± 150 MSSD and cement

7. Perform Pressure test and dry test at 7” Liner Lap

8. Hole cleaning inside 7” liner

9. Take CBL/VDL/ CCL/GR for evaluation of 7” liner cement bond

10. Hole cleaning to the top of cement

11. Complete the well as open hole

12. Run completion string as program and install X-Mas Tree.

2.3 Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSE &amp;amp; Q)

For this operation, special HSE focus points are:

 Well Control Situations and presence of H2S

 Crane lift and falling objects.

 Lifting of large and heavy equipment and continuous focus shall be kept on avoiding

dropped objects. The Drilling supervisor is responsible for reporting dropped objects in

the OIEC system.

 Work-orders, simultaneous operations/working on two levels, must be focused on during

the entire operations.

 SJA and pre-job meetings must be carried out for all non-standard operations.

 Pre-job safety meetings shall be held regularly before job start during casing running and

cementing.

 Unwanted incidents and deviations shall be reported.

 High standard on housekeeping

 Good Communication

2.4 Quality and Risk Assessment

Quantitative Risk Assessment, QRA, has been carried out on all main issues in the planning phase. The purpose was to guide the work according to identified risks for the operations, as well as to reduce the probability for incidents with potential HSE or commercial exposure. In the detailed planning phase, QRA has been an integral part of the work. All potential risks identified have been evaluated and mitigating actions have been implemented to reduce the risks to acceptable levels.

2.5 Drills

Drills while inside the 9 5/8” casing:

 H2S Drill

 Well Control Drills (Kick Drill, Pit Drill, Choke Drill)

 Fire &amp;amp; Abandonment Drill

 Pump over the burners (if the required connection is available)

3 Sequence of Operation

3.1 26” Hole Section

3.1.1 General

Casing Point 18 5/8" Shoe @ 150mFormation MishanRisks and Hole problems Bit Balled UpDeviation Control TotcoLogging N/ADrilling FluidBentonite MudMW 65-67pcfVis 70-80 SecPV ALAPYP 30-40Gel 15-20/20-30PH 9.5-10.5Drilling ParametersGPM 800-1000WOB 10-30 klbsRPM 90-100

3.1.2 Sequence of Operation

Make up 26” BHA as per BHA design, drill formation down to 150m (18-5/8” casing point in Aghajari formation). Use LCM pill if encountered heavy losses. If loss couldn’t be cured by LCM pill use cement plug(s) to cure same.

Note:

- 26” TD is based on 139m inside Aghajari formation.

- TD should be adjusted in such a way to have 2 meters of rat hole under casing shoe.

- The exact TD will be determined based on 18-5/8” casing tally.

- Do not forget to strap pipe while POOH.

- Drop Totco prior to POOH to evaluate the verticality of hole.

- Use following parameters to drill this hole section:

-WOB = Maximum available

-RPM = 90-130

-GPM = 800-1000

At TD, Circulate, clean hole. POOH, P/U 26” Reamer or 26” N.Bit stabilizer, RIH and condition the hole to section TD. Check for any fill. CBU on bottom.

مناقصه "طرح منصورآباد در قالب یک بسته یکپارچه از طرح عملیات محور

افزایش و نگهداشت تولید 27مخزن منتخب شرکت ملی مناطق نفتخیز جنوب"

شماره مناقصه: (م م/)97/0331

Page 53

POOH. If observed any indication of drag, run back to bottom. Wash and ream to make sure that the hole condition is good.

R/U 18-5/8” casing running gear. Perform Safety meeting.

Run ±150m (Approx. 14 Jts) 18-5/8", 87.5 ppf, J-55, BTS casing with guide shoe and stab- in collar to bottom as per casing program. Casing shoe should be adjusted in such a way to have 2 meters of rat hole and enough stick up (1.5 m) on rig floor. Fill casing by non LCM fresh mud joint by joint.

Note:

- Take care when running casing not to set down excessive weight if tight hole or

ledges are encountered.

Run stinger on 5” DP’s using the “C” Plate &amp;amp; 5” x 18-5/8” centralizer. Sting in. M/U &amp;amp; test cementing lines. Circulate for one casing annulus volume. While circulating, check the DP’s annulus for any return. Use all DP’s weight on the stinger, if observing any minor leakage through DP’s annulus.

Cement casing as per program. Any minor adjustment regarding the corrected depth will be done in due time. Displace with 6 bbls mud (2 bbls Short). Sting out. Check the float. Circulate to clean the DP. POOH.

Note:

- Based on the results obtained from cementing, decision will be made to perform top-up jobs.

Rest the 18-5/8” casing on the elevator until cement surface samples get hard. Check for casing to be center inside 30” conductor pipe. In case of any problem, report immediately.

If there is no cement return to surface, a top-up job should be performed to fill the annulus, stage by stage until cement reaches the surface. Use the same weight as the primary cement slurry. Ensure adequate X-over for connecting line pipe to cement line is available. The cement should be accelerated with max. 2% calcium chloride and no other additives. Wait for the top job cement to get hard.

Cut 30” conductor pipe from cellar base. L/D and remove same.

Rough cut 18-5/8” landing joint and L/D same. Dress casing neck suitable to install and to weld casing head housing. The distance between its top flange and ground level must be 1.73m.

Install and weld casing head housing 21 ¼” – 2000 psi on casing stub and test the sealing of welded casing (limit pressure to a maximum of 80% of the collapse strength of the casing or maximum 500 psi). Outlets to align with cellar stairs.

Note:

- Before installing the casing head housing, open all the test and plastic packing ports

and clean inside it with water and air.

- Do not forget to check the wear bushing with CHH and tie down flange before N/U

BOP’s.

Install tie down flange plus 21 ¼”x2000 psi spacer spool.

N/U 21 ¼”-2000 psi BOP’s and related lines. N/U bell nipple. Test BOP’s as per NIOC policy to 2000 psi pressure.

3.2.1 General

Casing Point 13 3/8" Shoe @1200mFormation Mishan, GS-7-6Risks and Hole problems Tight hole, Washout, LossesDeviation Control TotcoLogging CDR/GRDrilling FluidBentonite Mud , Salt Water , Salt/KCl/PHPA/Polymer MudMW 75-95 pcfVis 40-50 SecPV ALAPYP 14-20 lLbs/100ft²Gel 3-8 / 5-11PH 9.5-10Drilling ParametersGPM 800-1000WOB 40-60 klbsRPM 90-130

3.2.2 Sequence of Operation

 Make up 17-1/2” BHA as per BHA design. RIH, Tag top of cement. drill out cement,

possibility of shoe being backed off. In case, report immediately.

 Drill out rat hole. Drill ahead down to 174m.

 Circulate and clean hole, POOH and P/U new bit &amp;amp; S.Stab @ 20m, RIH to bottom.

Note:

Packed hole BHA assembly with PDC bit is Recommended to drill straight and fast the vertical hole.

 Use following parameters to drill this hole section:

Note:

- Drop Totco on each bit trip.

- TD should be adjusted in such a way to have 2 meters of rat hole for probable fillings.

- The Section TD maybe changed based on formation tops detected by the well site geologist.

- Do not forget to strap pipe while POOH.

 At section TD, circulate, clean hole. Perform wiper trip. Rest the hole for one hour

and observe same when @ 18-5/8” shoe. RIH. CBU on bottom. To either spot the pill

or not, consult with Drilling Manager.

 POOH. If observed any indication of drag, run back to bottom. Wash and ream to

make sure that the hole condition is good.

 R/U casing running gear. Perform Safety meeting.

 Run (13 3/8”, 68 ppf, N-80, BTC and 13 3/8”, 72 ppf, N-80, BTC) casing to bottom

mud each 10 joints.

 M/U cementing head. Load the plugs. WSS is to witness the loading. Test the lines to

3000 psi for 10 minutes.

 Cement casing as per program. Any minor adjustment regarding the corrected depth

will be done in due time. Displace with mud. Monitor for pressures. Record and report

the final pressure before bump the plug. Bump the plug with 500 psi over the final

circulating pressure or to 1500 psi max. Bleed off pressure. Check for back flow. If

any back flow observed, hold the pressure inside for the cement to thick.
